entities.summary: Prince Chitcharoen, the Prince Narisara Nuwattiwong, Prince Naris (นริศ) for short, né Chitcharoen (จิตรเจริญ), was a member of the royal family of Siam, minister, general and scholar. A polymath, he became known as "the great craftsman of Siam" and "the prince master". The anniversary of his birth, 28 April, is celebrated in Thailand as "Prince Naris Day".
